description: We are engineering students from TED University, Ankara. Last summer one of us worked at TÜBİTAK Space and built an anomaly detector for NASA cFS flight software on a small board with no FPU. Now we want to use the same idea for astronaut health. On Mars, help from Earth can take 20 minutes, so the spacecraft must notice problems by itself. Our system runs on real flight hardware and catches faults that simple limit checks miss.
